resources.string: Persistent sensor collection and durable upload status
Phone connected. Continue setup below, then tap Start durable collection.

Samsung/Galaxy requires both steps:
1. Open Samsung app settings → Battery → Unrestricted.
2. Open Never sleeping apps settings → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Training Sensors.
Use the buttons above for each step. If the second button only opens App info, use the manual path: Settings → Battery and device care → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps.
Android cannot reliably verify the Never sleeping apps list, so tick the confirmation only after completing both steps.
